title: Rabbi David Tawil: Intro to Tanach & Yehoshua Chapter 1

chapters.title: Introduction to Tanach
chapters.about: Three sections of Tanach, Torah, Navi, Ketuvim

chapters.title: Yehoshua's background
chapters.about: Yehoshua as student of Moshe, previous roles

chapters.title: The condition of Torah
chapters.about: Upholding the laws of the Torah

chapters.title: First command to the nation
chapters.about: Preparing for three days, crossing the Jordan

summary: Rabbi Tawil introduces the structure of Tanach, explaining the distinct roles of Torah, Navi, and Ketuvim, and how they relate to the transmission of divine messages. He then begins a study of the first chapter of Yehoshua, focusing on the transition of leadership from Moshe Rabbenu to Yehoshua and the importance of maintaining the legacy of the Torah.
subjects: The tribes of Reuven, Gad, and Menashe
questions: What are the three sections of Tanach and how do they differ?
Why is the book of Yehoshua not part of the Torah?
How did the people respond to Yehoshua's new leadership?
What does it mean that Yehoshua is the 'servant of Moshe'?
Why did some tribes want to stay on the eastern side of the Jordan?
